newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AGA signs 60 mln mark contract in Germany.
newsitem.headline: AGA signs 60 mln mark contract in Germany.

text.p: Swedish gas company AGA AB said on Wednesday it signed a long-term contract worth 60 million marks with Edelstahlwerke Buderus AG in Wetzlar, Germany.
The contract is for the supply of compressed air, oxygen, nitrogen, argon and hydrogen to the German company's steelworks.

AGA said it will invest 14 million marks in a remote controlled on site air gas plant with a yearly capacity of over 100 Mm3 of compressed air, oxygen and nitrogen. AGA will also supply argon and hydrogen.
"This new on site supply concept will considerably decrease the gas supply costs," AGA said in a statement.
"The energy consumption will decrease about 50 percent corresponding to 13 MkWh a year."
Edelstahlwerke Buderus, which manufactures rolling and forging products, uses gas in melting processes in electric arc furnaces and also in heat treatment processes.
The company is part of the Buderus group BUPG.F.
